items.why: The baseline to start with: anticipating tasks from desktop activity, with a benchmark to match.
items.whyZh: 最适合入门的基线工作：从桌面活动预判任务，并配有对应评测。

items.why: Shows the whole decision: stay silent, step in briefly or assist in depth, with interruption cost made explicit.
items.whyZh: 完整呈现主动决策：保持沉默、简短介入或深度协助，并明确打扰成本。

items.why: Asks what most evaluations skip: did people find the help acceptable, well-timed and the right intensity?
items.whyZh: 回答多数评测忽略的问题：人们是否认为这次帮助可接受、时机合适、力度恰当？

items.why: A mainstream example of ongoing responsibility: research and checks that continue between conversations.
items.whyZh: “持续负责”的主流案例：对话之外仍在继续调研和检查。

items.why: A standing goal drives background work, and it returns when conditions change or approval is needed.
items.whyZh: 由长期目标驱动后台工作，在情况变化或需要批准时回来找你。

items.why: Scheduled and event-triggered routines in product form, including when to escalate to the user.
items.whyZh: 以产品形态呈现定时与事件触发的例程，也包括何时上报给用户。

items.why: Read its heartbeat design to see how a runtime checks for meaningful change and suppresses noise.
items.whyZh: 读它的 heartbeat 设计，了解运行时如何检查有意义的变化并抑制噪音。

items.why: A compact reference for wake-up logic: durable goals, model-selected cadence and action caps.
items.whyZh: 唤醒逻辑的精简参考：持久目标、模型选择节奏和行动上限。

items.why: An open desktop app that turns screen context into tips and todos: an ambient loop you can run yourself.
items.whyZh: 开源桌面应用，把屏幕上下文变成提示和待办，可以亲手运行环境感知闭环。

rows.en: A schedule or event you configured
rows.note: On the boundary: it starts unprompted, but you chose when.
rows.noteZh: 处于边界：无需提示即可启动，但时机由你选定。

rows.note: The goal is yours. The agent chooses when to work and return.
rows.noteZh: 目标是你的，何时工作、何时回来由智能体决定。

rows.en: The agent's own read of context
rows.zh: 智能体自己对情境的判断
rows.note: The strongest form: nobody specified this moment in advance.
rows.noteZh: 最强的形式：没有人预先指定这个时刻。
